description: Use this when the user asks whether AI answer engines cite their website. Asks one answer engine (Perplexity) three customer-style questions written from the site's own pages and returns each question, the sites it cited, whether this site was one of them, and the date. A result for the same site from the last 24 hours is returned again instead of asking again.

brand.description: Optional business name, used to keep it out of the questions.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. example.com.

name: check_citations
title: Check which sites an AI answer engine cites
